## What changed

- `crates/hharness/src/formative.rs` (+602, new) — the
  `hh-formative-withheld/1` record: closed six-leg vocabulary
  `gate_readout|pins_frozen|surface_vocabulary|refusal_vocabulary|
  cohort_absent|claims_withheld`; records-in leg evaluators over
  supplied facts only (`evaluate_pins`, `evaluate_vocabulary`,
  `evaluate_refusals`, `evaluate_cohort`, `evaluate_claims` + the
  R5.50 `evaluate_gate` consumed unchanged) — never manufacturing a
  participant, a session, an observation or a claim;
  `withheld|failed|inconclusive` fold — definitive failure
  dominates undetermined; `assemble()` refuses any leg set not
  `LEGS`-unique-and-complete; `packet_id` minted last over the
  canonical record minus itself; `Disposition` re-exported from
  `confirm` (one closed vocabulary, never a second implementation).
  **Facade home, not `hh-env`:** the exercised R5.45/R5.28 surfaces
  (`examples`, `recipe`) live in the facade and `hh-env` cannot
  reach them without a dev-graph cycle (facade→env is the shipping
  edge) — placement recorded on the contract.
- `crates/hharness/tests/r5_53.rs` (+853, new) — the battery: the
  eleven pinned inputs re-verified for real via `check_pins`; the
  §7/§8 formative-surface vocabulary read from the landed machinery
  (incl. contrib/trace check ids read off real checker runs) and
  asserted verbatim; the eleven exercised cases driven through the
  real `ExampleCard::from_json`/`run_example`/`RecipePlan::from_json`
  paths plus a real `ex-03` scratch run and the two real static
  checkers over a temp-dir store (pure in-process — the refusals
  fire before any execution, the example run executes a committed
  card's own scripted lane on scratch, never a participant act);
  the absent-cohort and withheld-claims folds; and the negative
  legs (nonzero cohort fact, consent/session/outreach/telemetry
  attempted, an exercised case producing/admitting, a claim of any
  sign, DF-H9-1 closed, pin/vocabulary mismatch, a malformed leg
  set — each `refused`; `inconclusive` never folds to `withheld`).
- `crates/hharness/src/lib.rs` (+5) — `pub mod formative;` + doc.
- `crates/hh-env/src/preflight.rs` (+4) — `LegVerdict::to_json`
  widened `pub(crate)`→`pub`: the one verdict codec shared with
  the facade packet, never duplicated (doc comment updated).
- `docs/build/reports/2026-11-04-r5.53-formative-withheld.json`
  — the emitted packet (via `HH_FORMATIVE_WITHHELD_EMIT`, never
  hand-written; re-diffed **byte-identical** at pass-2 close).
- `docs/build/runs/R5.53.md` — the run ledger (incl. the STOP
  record and the orchestrator's ruling section).
- `docs/tickets/232_R5.53__formative.md` — fleshing + size-ruling
  amendment note.

No new Cargo dependency at all (the facade already carries every
needed edge; tests inherit them), no new RecordKind, event class,
store or codec — `hharness_env::preflight::{Leg,LegVerdict,
PinnedArtifact,check_pins}` + `hharness_env::plugin::{GateFacts,
evaluate_gate}` + `hharness_env::confirm::Disposition` +
`crate::examples::{ExampleCard,run_example,code,CARD_SCHEMA,
EX02_FIXTURE_SCHEMA,RUNNER_VERSION}` + `crate::recipe::{RecipePlan,
code,RECIPE_VERSION}` consumed unchanged.
